brief:
Israel's military operations have reduced olive tree cultivation in Gaza from two million trees to approximately 150,000, the Electronic Intifada reported. The collapse has devastated the harvest season, once a cornerstone of Palestinian agricultural production and livelihoods in the territory.

The decimation of olive groves represents a broader destruction of Gaza's agricultural infrastructure during the ongoing conflict. Olive cultivation has historically provided income and food security for thousands of farming families across the territory.
dek: Israel’s genocide has decimated olive cultivation in Gaza, reducing the number of olive trees from two million to 150,000.
title: Israeli operations devastate Gaza's olive cultivation
